name: TestFlight
author: Enplace
summary: Get an iPhone app's builds onto your own phone with TestFlight, and see each build through.
description: Goes on an app product beside the App Store plugin, and uses its bundle ID and the product's Apple account, so there's nothing to enter twice. It makes a private tester group with you in it that gets every build, with no wait for Apple's review, and shows each build as Apple processes it until it's ready on your phone. Press Send to TestFlight and it asks for a build from whoever is the Builds step of its track (like Xcode Cloud), else an agent on your Mac or you in Xcode, with the version from Versions and the next build number. It writes each build's What to test from the work done since the last one, and shares the builds with Release cycle. Its page lists every build with how testers use it (installs, sessions, crashes), their feedback, sizes and where each build came from; usage and feedback are read hourly, or when you press Check now. When an Autopilot round ends, it can put the round on your phone: one build, with the round's changes and how to try each as its What to test.
